visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large giraffe with a distinct brown and beige reticulated pattern walks slowly from left to right within a spacious zoo enclosure. The background is filled with dense green trees and foliage under bright, natural daylight. A chain-link fence separates the animal's habitat from the viewer's path. (2) The scene cuts to two men in an outdoor setting. The primary individual wears black-rimmed glasses and a light grey short-sleeved shirt, focusing intently on a professional camera mounted on a stabilizer gimbal. His hands are actively adjusting the equipment. An assistant stands in the background near a building. (3) The giraffe is shown again, walking through an open metallic gate in the fence. A standard orange basketball is suspended from the gate structure as an enrichment object. The animal moves calmly past the gate into another section of the grassy enclosure while the camera tracks its movement.
